name: lib/rate-limiter
title: Rate limiter
summary: An integer token bucket (units of 1/windowMs token): sustained rate exactly limit per window, burst only raises the ceiling, and queued callers reserve their token.

config.name: queueExcess
config.rule: Wait instead of rejecting when the wait is at most maxWaitMs.

behaviour.rule: One token = windowMs units; capacity C = (limit + burstAllowance) * windowMs; the bucket starts full.
Refill adds (now - lastRefill) * limit units, capped at C; a clock that steps back adds nothing.

With level >= windowMs: take a token, wait 0. Else wait = ceil((windowMs - level) / limit); with queueExcess and wait <= maxWaitMs the token is reserved now (level may go negative) and the caller sleeps wait; else rejected with retryAfterMs = wait.
remaining(now) = floor(max(level, 0) / windowMs); isAllowed agrees with execute.
